product.name: Presti AI Background Generator
product.description: An AI-powered tool that creates photorealistic lifestyle product images for furniture brands by generating backgrounds and staging furniture virtually.

product.name: Color Variation Tool
product.description: A feature that allows users to create multiple color variations of furniture products by selecting regions and applying custom color codes with AI assistance.

product.name: Background Removal and Image Enhancement
product.description: A service that automatically removes backgrounds from product images and enhances them by adding accessories and adjusting lighting to improve visual appeal.

product.name: Virtual Staging with AI-Generated Backgrounds
product.description: A feature that creates AI-generated backgrounds for furniture products based on user descriptions or inspiration images, producing high-resolution lifestyle scenes.

product.name: Image Editing Tools
product.description: Tools that enable users to edit generated images by removing unwanted objects, adjusting product proportions, and modifying image elements.
